from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u081/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-af8419a1.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height else 0
    occupied_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(value != 0 for value in row)]
    if not occupied_rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(occupied_rows)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        shift = r - bottom
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 0:
                new_c = c + shift
                if 0 <= new_c < width:
                    out[r][new_c] = value
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
